title: Drivers and Operators
description:
POSITION VACANCY
Hebou Constructions (PNG) Limited is a tier-one, family-owned civil engineering contractor. We have been operating in Papua New Guinea for over 50 years and is proud of its history and its reputation within the Country.
We have a vacancy for
DRIVERS
&
OPERATORS
positions in the Fleet Division. The position is suited to a candidate who is seeking a stable long-term future with great career prospects.
Position Available:
Multi-Skills Operators
Tipper Truck Drivers
Truck & Dog Trailer Drivers
Grader Operators
Doser Operators
Excavator Operators
Roller Operators
Requirements:
* Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in operating machines & dump truck.
*
Must hold a current Class 4, 6 & 7 Drivers License
* Must have Operating Certificates if available.
* Must have work references & certificates from previous employers
All applications must be submitted electronically to the following email address no later than the 7
